title: Regular vs Diffused Reflection
subject: Physics
objective: A mirror and a white wall both reflect light; only the mirror shows your face. Smooth surfaces keep rays parallel; rough ones scatter them.

fill.q: In diffused reflection each ray still obeys i = ____.
A wet road looks shiny because water makes the surface ____.

tf.q: Diffused reflection breaks the laws of reflection.
tf.explain: Each ray obeys i = r at its own tiny facet.

tf.q: A mirror forms an image by regular reflection.
We can read a book from any angle because of diffused reflection.

tf.explain: Scattered rays cannot form an image.

ar.a: A rough surface gives diffused reflection.
ar.r: Its tiny facets face different directions.
ar.explain: Each ray obeys i = r at its own facet, so the rays scatter.

ar.a: Diffused reflection violates the laws of reflection.
ar.r: Diffused reflection does not form an image.
ar.explain: A is false; R is true.

mcq.q: In diffused reflection, parallel incident rays:
Glare from a wet road is due to:
options: regular reflection from a smoother surface

short.q: Why does diffused reflection not form an image, though each ray obeys the laws?
short.solution: The surface has tiny facets facing different ways; each ray obeys i = r at its facet, but the reflected rays go in different directions, so they cannot meet to form an image.

short.q: Give one use of each type of reflection.
short.solution: Regular: mirrors for seeing images. Diffused: lets us see objects and read books from any angle.

match.explain: Surface smoothness decides the type of reflection.
